name: The Cat Between Us
source:
Co-managing the school’s stray cat fund should be easy – if Miko and Hina agreed on anything. Miko thinks Hina’s too gentle, Hina thinks Miko’s too harsh. They bicker over meals, names, and posters… until a storm leaves them stuck in the clubroom with a sick kitten.

[From [url=https://seris3ri.itch.io/the-cat-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
